verdict.rationale: The axis applies: 1Password stores one-time passwords (docs-20), so portability of those tokens to a new phone is a fair question. But nothing in the pack documents a new-device setup or a guided one-step migration of OTP tokens. The export, CSV import and Credential Exchange features cover moving data between different apps, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for a device-to-device transfer.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step
